decision.q: where does wake_parent hook into the event path
options: inside Agents.watch(), which Servex overrides for the dashboard stream
a new call from Agent.emit(), the one seam every event already passes through
decision.why: Servex.Agents extends Agents and overrides watch() entirely for the dashboard socket, so any logic placed inside the base watch() would never run once Servex is the host — emit() is the seam nothing can skip
decision.rule: code#2 (every method a seam, but the seam has to be one nothing overrides away)

log.msg: wake_parent(child, kind) added to Agents; Agent.emit() calls it on type result (done/blocked by BLOCKED prefix) and type error; tracks last_text/last_error on the agent instance; card() and spawn_agent's schema both gained parent so the tree is visible everywhere, not just the registry (readme.md already flagged this as the one missing field)

assign.outcome: **A child's landing now wakes its parent, and it's proven both ways.** `Agents.wake_parent(child, kind)` in `Servex/agents/Agents.js` sends a parent ONE message the moment a child with a `parent` ends a turn, is stopped, or errors — `done:`/`blocked:`/`error:` plus its last words, queued behind whatever the parent is doing. Run 1 (wake off) reproduced the old bug: a real task mastermind spawned two Haiku minions, they finished, and it sat idle forever — `both.txt` never written, cost $1.07. Run 2 (wake on, same brief) fixed it: two `agent_msg` lines landed in the parent's own log before the turn that wrote `both.txt` ("alpha beta") and replied DONE — cost $0.69, 46s, 3 turns. Along the way, a real bug got fixed: `roles.js`'s `task-mastermind` role defaulted to a permission mode that silently refused its own `spawn_agent` calls — now `bypassPermissions`. Registry rows and `say.mjs state`'s MASTERMINDS block both show the tree while it runs. Left open: the day page's `children:` needs `sub-mastermind-live` added by whoever owns that shared file (outside my fence) so the report page shows on the board — it works standalone at the link below either way.
